name: global-var-test-297b184697/global_variable_init-v.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString, toBalString.

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions"; value entries include cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString and toBalString, but not cloneReadOnly.
reason: The asserted global initialization depends on cloning a map into readonly data with lm.cloneReadOnly() and cloning an array with value:clone(la). Neither lang.value operation is in the supported positive list, so the complete case requires unsupported functionality.
test_design_notes: Assertions check initialized scalar globals, readonly map contents via a record type test, and cloned array contents.
